newsitem.title: FINLAND: Helsinki seen starting down on cue from Wall St.
newsitem.headline: Helsinki seen starting down on cue from Wall St.

text.p: Shares were seen starting lower on Monday after profit-taking in U.S. stocks knocked the Dow industrials down 1.6 percent and Nokia ended lower on Wall Street on Friday, brokers said.
"It will be enough for Nokia to open down, and we'll be in negative ground," one broker said, predicting an overall decline of between one and two percent for the day.
Nokia ended in New York at the equivalent of about 426.30 markka, almost 10.00 below its Friday Helsinki close.
The S&P paper stocks index fell 1.9 percent on Friday, pointing the way down for forestries here, brokers said.
